notes.title: Post-launch patch 1 (10.8.6)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added main volume slider to option menu
[*] Added a display for the current version id in the main menu
[*] Proper gamepad (xbox) support for the main, pause and option menus (especialy resolution dropdown)
[*] Fix: the light on pods' circular switch now flick properly
[/list]
[b]Stay tuned for more upcoming releases and patchs.[/b]

A huge thanks to all who got the game and their support during developement!

Arkitek,
Kernel Red Games
